photos.c: Back Page Photo: One of the most expressive shots of the year. Belgravian Darren Campbell representing Great Britain & Northern Ireland continues the Linford Christie tradition by winning the European Games 100 metres Championship in a record time of 10.04 seconds.
Relaxed and smooth, Darren Campbell eases to an impressive win in the early rounds of the 100 metres at Budapest.
Darren Campbell is interviewed over the public address and explains to the French crowd how the British 4 x 100 metres squad is going to give the Americans big trouble at the Sydney 2000 Olympics.
Bottom right - Darren Campbell celebrated Olympic silver after a brilliant run in the Olympic 200 metres where he became third fastest Briton of all time.
Left: Sprint Ace Darren Campbell scooped the prizes at the European Champion Clubs Cup competition. Best runner, best overall performance and Captain of the winning Belgrave team!
Right below: The 200 metres gave Darren Campbell the chance to show what he can do in the intermediate sprint and took him one step closer to that Olympic Silver Medal.
